svg.text: A | One-coordinate intervals are not automatically a joint box
Frozen head: 9 independent rows, each with bias + column0 weight. Accepted dyadic scale: 8/16.
Orange: original013 rectangle Green: certified014 box Blue: original codes Pale: exact feasible bands
B | Proof: every legal board constrains b above/below a rounded affine function of w.
C | All 65,536 signed16 weight codes per row audited. Shading sampled only for drawing; saved bands are exact.
Grid-maximal is not continuous-optimal. Membership scores are signed set indicators, never confidence.
